name: medtrack
description: MedTrack — medication adherence platform (API, web, mobile)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @medtrack/api && npm run build -w @medtrack/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @medtrack/shared && npm run test -w @medtrack/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @medtrack/mobile && tsc -b packages/shared apps/api
